title: Vehicle Selector Pro — Live Application Walkthrough

scenes.narration: This is Vehicle Selector Pro, running live in production. Everything you see is the real deployed application.
Everything begins with the vehicle. Pick the year, the make, the model - each dropdown narrows to what actually exists.
Hit find parts, and the storefront routes through a signed App Proxy, returning only parts that fit the vehicle you chose.
Open any product, and the compatibility badge does the convincing - a guaranteed exact fit, live on the page.
My Garage remembers every vehicle you own. Switch between a truck and a sedan without ever starting over.
Behind the scenes, merchants command everything from a Polaris dashboard - the same deployment, live.
Every product-to-vehicle rule lives in one matrix: direct fit, universal, or held for review.
Vehicle Selector Pro. The right part for the right vehicle - first time, every time.
